title: Croatian Pasta Bake
description: A simple and satisfying pasta bake infused with the flavors of Croatia. This hearty dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the crostini and cook until crispy.
Add the spicy paprika to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked pasta, crostini mixture, and grated cheese.
Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with the remaining olive oil.
Transfer the pasta mixture to the prepared baking dish and top with additional grated cheese.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
